records.name: three.dev
records.tagline: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
records.description: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.

records.name: Omnigraph
records.tagline: Open source graph database for your AI agents
records.description: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

records.name: ⌘+L
records.tagline: Edit your website like Figma!
records.description: Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

records.name: YouArt Desktop App
records.tagline: Codex for creative team
records.description: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

records.name: Crossfade
records.tagline: Let your coding agent design in your open Figma file
records.description: Crossfade connects your coding agent to the Figma Design, FigJam or Slides file you have open. Select a layer and ask: it builds with your components and design system, checks its own screenshot, and leaves dev handoff notes on the layers. Unlike Figma's MCP server: • No call limits, on any plan • No Full seat needed to write • Fonts on your Mac just work • Images placed in the same run • $19 once, no usage fees Private by design: no Crossfade server, and the bridge answers only your agent.

records.name: Jot 2.0
records.tagline: Select text, tap Shift twice, it's a markdown file
records.description: Jot is a capture inbox for macOS. Select anything, tap Shift twice, and it becomes a markdown file in a folder you own. Hold fn to dictate into any app. Ctrl+Opt+A grabs a region of the screen to mark up. Jot 2.0 is rewritten in Rust, off Electron: 675 MB down to 43 MB on Apple silicon. No account, no sync. Speech runs on your Mac with 59 local models. A CLI and an MCP server let Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read, search and tag your notes. One-time license.

records.name: Nameshot
records.tagline: Your screenshots named automatically
records.description: A tiny app that solves a big problem: naming your messy stash of "Screenshot 2025-12-15 at 06.59.24" nonsense entirely on device via Apple Intelligence.

records.name: Insight7 Voice AI Agents
records.tagline: AI voice agents that call your customers for you
records.description: Insight7 Voice AI Agents call the customers your team never gets to. Describe the calls in one sentence, and the script, questions and calling schedule are drafted for you. Take the test call yourself before anyone else is called. Run it once, on a schedule, or let your systems trigger calls when a renewal comes due or a sign-up stalls. Every conversation comes back in one report: outcomes, patterns and the customers who need a person.

records.name: Customer.io Fall Release
records.tagline: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments
records.description: Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.

records.name: Neura HQ
records.tagline: The agentic conversational storefront for consumer brands
records.description: In B2C, every touchpoint is a stay-or-leave decision. Customers find you through ads, social, or stores, and leave the moment they don’t get what they want. Neura is the agentic conversational storefront that meets them in that moment, wherever they are. It recommends, shares offers, checks online and in-store stock, points them to the nearest store, tracks orders and stays with them through the whole journey, like your best person on the floor. Set it up in minutes, just by talking to it.

records.name: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
records.tagline: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market
records.description: Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

records.name: Hoy for Mac
records.tagline: Walkie-talkie meets AirDrop meets Messages
records.description: Hoy puts your people in your Mac's menu bar, on top of everything you do. Drop a file on a face. Hold to talk, and Hoy writes it down as you speak. Show your screen. Hand over a to-do. Every face is a channel, with one person or a group, and a link is all it takes to bring someone in. No sign-up, no middleman: your channels live in your own iCloud and there is no Hoy server. Free, with a pay-once Pro. Needs macOS 26. iPhone and iPad are coming soon.

records.name: Grok Bot 1.0
records.tagline: Bots work together alongside your team
records.description: Bots now work with your whole team, take on work without being asked, and get more done, faster.

records.name: Harness Memory
records.tagline: Long-term memory for agents, across every harness
records.description: Harness Memory gives every harness agent its own long-term memory. Pick a memory engine (Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own) and plug it into different agent harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. Memory can be shared across agent harnesses, with fine-grained access control. Open source in Community Edition and available on HarnessRouter Cloud.

records.name: Plurai Simulation
records.tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
records.description: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

records.name: Klang
records.tagline: Team memory of meetings and calls, on our own speech models
records.description: Klang is a memory of all your organisation's important conversations. Record meetings in the room, calls and online meetings with the iPhone and Android app, the Mac and Windows apps (beta) or the web. Klang connects them into one shared repository you can search, question and analyse, or open to your AI agents through MCP. Under the hood, we're an AI speech lab: we train our own speech models, like Pianissimo, our open model for Swedish and Danish. Built in Sweden. Free to start.

records.name: Infinite Drive
records.tagline: A cloud drive you stream to give your laptop infinite space
records.description: Fabric is a cloud drive that gives your laptop infinite space. Files take zero disk space and stream instantly, even 4K video into your editor. Find anything by describing it with AI search. For creatives, video editors and remote teams.

records.name: Spacefast by Automattic
records.tagline: Give your AI agents a place to build, run, and ship
records.description: Spacefast is a new way to ship websites and apps with the AI you already use. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your favorite agent, and publish your project with a simple request. Spacefast handles hosting, databases, domains, file uploads, and version history. Share private links, collect feedback directly on your pages, and let your agent make updates. Built by Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com. Free to start, with no extra AI subscription.

records.name: LeaseWire
records.tagline: Lease abstraction, wired to your model.
records.description: Commercial lease abstracts, filled straight into your own Excel underwriting model. Send your blank template once, then any lease PDF up to 200 pages, scans and amendments included. Each lease is read twice and compared field by field, and every value comes back with its page and exact quote, checked before delivery. Formulas, named ranges and macros stay intact. Usually back in 24 hours. From $150 per lease, no subscription.

records.name: Sluice
records.tagline: Room to build on your Mac, even with 20 agents at once
records.description: Building with AI agents means many dev slots at once, each with its own Docker environment, node_modules and build data. Sluice lives in your menu bar, knows where Xcode, Docker, Rust, Go and npm hide leftovers, and frees them safely. Never during a build.

records.name: Skysoon
records.tagline: Beautiful weather timelines and countdowns to what's next.
records.description: Skysoon counts down to what the sky does next: "12 min till it rains", "8h 21m till the sun sets". One glowing timeline shows the next hour, day or week. Free to download, with no account, no ads and no tracking. Skysoon+ is a one-time unlock.

records.name: Adobe AI Assistant
records.tagline: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
records.description: Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

records.name: Toki Matter
records.tagline: The Al agent that advances your matters
records.description: Personal agents can take work off your plate. Toki makes sure you never lose track of it. See everything Toki is handling, follow each goal’s progress in real time, step in when a decision needs you, then hand it back. Instead of managing the agent itself, you stay focused on the bigger picture while Toki keeps the work moving.

records.name: Yogurt
records.tagline: Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
records.description: Yogurt takes AI meeting notes without joining your call as a bot. It records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams in the background, shows a live transcript, and writes a summary with next steps when the call ends. Ask questions across all your meetings, a folder or one call, even mid-meeting. Replay the full audio, share notes with Claude or ChatGPT via MCP, and recordings stop when the call does. Free, open source, no account. Everything stays on your computer. Works on Mac/Windows/Linux.

records.name: Marqly 7.0
records.tagline: Bookmarks you can query to find the things you saved
records.description: Marqly 7.0 is a whole new Marqly. Your saves live in Collections: a moodboard Home, boards as stacks of their own covers, and Ask, a chat that answers from your own bookmarks with a source under every claim. Ask spots dead links and duplicates, files strays and tags new saves, and nothing changes until you approve. Free accounts get 5 Ask questions on us; Pro brings your library into ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Web, all major browsers, iPhone and Android.

records.name: Foxpit
records.tagline: Run Claude Code, Codex & OpenCode as one AI team
records.description: Foxpit turns your AI coding agents into one team in a 3D office. Fox, the lead, splits the task; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode build it in real terminals. Shared memory, auto-resume after usage limits, approvals in one place. Windows, macOS, Linux.

records.name: Didit MCP
records.tagline: The MCP server for identity verification and fraud checks
records.description: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Codex to Didit. Ask in plain English: your agent builds KYC and KYB flows, checks IDs against government databases, screens people and wallets for AML and back-tests fraud rules.

records.name: Gemini Decisions API
records.tagline: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
records.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

records.name: Cloudways Velocity
records.tagline: Managed Node.js hosting. Always warm, never off.
records.description: Deploy production-ready Node.js apps in minutes. Managed infrastructure, enterprise-grade security, and flat, predictable pricing, so there are no cold starts to worry about, and no billing surprises.

records.name: Gnista
records.tagline: Run more coding agents, watch none of them
records.description: Gnista keeps an eye on Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and every other coding agent you start, in your MacBook’s notch or menu bar, and tells you the moment one needs you.

records.name: mang.sh
records.tagline: Natural Language  to Terminal Commands
records.description: Describe a task; Mang proposes a terminal command. Inspect it and explicitly confirm before execution. Use local Ollama or OpenRouter. Built in Rust. MIT-licensed.

records.name: CanyonOS
records.tagline: The One Platform for Scaling your Agentic Apps
records.description: CanyonOS is a workflow-aware platform to build, scale, observe and manage agentic applications. It carries every call between your agents, so it can automatically find and scale just the ones holding up your workflow and show how much each agent adds to your costs, with no tracing code to write. Your agents stay plain Python. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

records.name: AirWave
records.tagline: Internet radio, at home on every Apple device
records.description: AirWave brings thousands of radio stations from around the world to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and CarPlay in one native app. Rewind live radio up to 30 minutes, see every song that played, shape the sound with a 10-band EQ, and keep it one click away in your Mac menu bar. No account, no ads, no tracking. Listening is free. AirWave Pro adds recording, Sonos, iCloud sync, Last.fm, widgets and the Apple Watch and Apple TV apps for $4.99 a year.

records.name: Blendra
records.tagline: Record a flow once and get a Playwright test project you own
records.description: Record a flow in desktop Chrome and get end-to-end tests as a Playwright project: specs, page objects, locator files, test data and a GitHub Actions workflow. After each step, tick what your app showed (a message, a URL, a heading). Each tick is a check with the real value. No LLM writes the code: same recording, same output. It runs in your CI without Blendra. On Blendra's cloud runner, a failed test gets a rule-based cause with evidence. Free plan. 7-day Pro trial, no card.

records.name: Oxagen
records.tagline: Mission control for agents to share + maintain context
records.description: Oxagen links every coding-agent run to the people, work, code changes, costs, and outcomes behind it. Engineering teams use that record to direct their agents, share proven instructions and tools, enforce policy on the actions agents take through Oxagen, and get better at the next task. We built it so teams can see real returns on their AI spend, and so great engineers can still do excellent work in the age of agents.

records.name: WizardNote
records.tagline: Voice notes your phone transcribes, saved as markdown
records.description: Voice notes that never send your audio anywhere. WizardNote transcribes on your phone (Whisper, offline), learns your vocabulary, and strips emails, phone numbers and addresses before any AI sees the text (Pro adds names and companies). Summaries use the AI you pick: Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano, your own server, your API key, or our EU cloud. Pro saves markdown notes with tasks and speakers to your Obsidian vault. No account. Pro is one-time.

records.name: Offstage Cloud
records.tagline: On-demand macOS sandboxes for AI agents
records.description: Offstage gives AI agents and CI an on-demand macOS sandbox. Build iOS and Mac apps with Xcode, launch them in the Simulator, or hand an agent a real desktop. Pay per second with no 24-hour minimum. A 10-minute run costs about $0.18.

records.name: Aarthat Weather
records.tagline: Live Forecast Dashboard
records.description: Live, beautiful weather forecasts.

records.name: Lynk-X
records.tagline: A ticketing and community platform focused on interactions.
records.description: All-in-one event ticketing and community platform. Zero-friction mobile ticketing, private event forums, live attendee chat and shared media walls.

records.name: Pullday
records.tagline: Track Pokémon cards and estimated prices in AUD
records.description: Pullday helps Australian Pokémon collectors browse cards and sets, check estimated prices in AUD, and track a collection and watchlist. Free calculators help compare grading and import costs.

records.name: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
records.tagline: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market
records.description: Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

records.name: Manufacturing Inventory Management
records.tagline: Optimize Stock Control with Intelligent Automation
records.description: Discover how a manufacturing inventory management system helps Saudi factories minimize stock wastage, optimize inventory costs, and streamline production workflows. Gain real-time visibility into raw materials, monitor stock levels, automate inventory tracking, and improve demand forecasting. With accurate inventory data and efficient warehouse operations, Implement smarter inventory control to improve productivity, strengthen supply chain performance, and support sustainable business growth.

records.name: NeuroCart: Lists & Expenses
records.tagline: Shop Together, Stay Organized, Spend Smarter
records.description: # NeuroCart – Shared Grocery Lists & Expenses Make everyday shopping and household management easier with NeuroCart! Create shared grocery lists, organize shopping items, manage household inventory and split expenses with family, friends, roommates or anyone you shop with. NeuroCart brings shopping lists, collaborative planning, pantry management and expense tracking together in one convenient app. Create and Manage Grocery Lists Plan your shopping without forgetting important items.

records.name: Royal patrika
records.tagline: ट्रेन हादसे से पहले क्या हुआ था? सामने आया लोको पायलट Video
records.description: गुवाहाटी: असम में Kolkata-Sairang Express के हादसे से पहले का एक वीडियो सामने आया है, जिसने दुर्घटना से जुड़ी परिस्थितियों पर कई सवाल खड़े कर दिए हैं। वीडियो में लोको पायलट ट्रेन की गति को नियंत्रित करने की कोशिश करता दिखाई दे रहा है। वीडियो में लोको पायलट की बातचीत से संकेत मिलता है कि ट्रेन की स्पीड कम करने और उसे नियंत्रित करने में परेशानी आ रही थी। इस दौरान ब्रेक सिस्टम को लेकर भी चिंता जाहिर की गई। हादसे से कुछ समय पहले ट्रेन को रोकने की कोशिश किए जाने की बात वीडियो में सामने आती है।

records.name: Bright Blue Gemstones
records.tagline: Natural Gemstones in Bellandur, Bengaluru
records.description: Bright Blue Gemstones is a premier gemstone dealer in Bangalore, specializing in 100% natural, certified precious and semi-precious stones. From authentic Blue Sapphires (Neelam) to Rubies and Emeralds, we provide ethically sourced, astrology-grade gemstones and custom jewelry to customers across Bengaluru and online. Located in Bangalore, Bright Blue Gemstones offers premium, lab-certified gemstones for custom jewelry, investment, and Vedic astrology.

records.name: AFS COUNSELING SERVICES, P.C.
records.tagline: Therapy & Immigration Evaluations in Chicago
records.description: AFS Counseling Services, P.C. is a Chicago-based mental health practice offering online therapy across Illinois for teens and adults. Founded by Alice Solis, MA, LCPC, it provides support for anxiety, depression, stress, burnout, self-esteem, and life transitions. Services also include clinical immigration evaluations, clinical supervision, case consultation, trauma-informed training, and professional workshops, with a focus on individualized, culturally responsive care.

records.name: Do It First
records.tagline: Lock your apps until you do what matters
records.description: Do It First is an iPhone app blocker that locks Instagram, TikTok or any app you choose at a set time until you finish a real task you planned — read 10 pages, study 30 minutes, go for a run — and confirm it with a photo. Every mission earns XP, keeps your streak, unlocks medals and evolves a pixel-art companion through five worlds. Built on Apple Screen Time, no account, your data stays on your iPhone. Free to start; Pro adds up to 10 protected missions.

records.name: Ruxel Studio
records.tagline: Visual drag-and-drop UI editor for Rust inside VS Code
records.description: Tired of guessing margins and recompiling Rust UI? Ruxel Studio is a native VS Code drag-and-drop builder that respects your code. It features Lossless AST Sync (preserves your custom logic and comments), real-time CRDT multiplayer, and supports Iced, egui, Slint & Dioxus out of the box. I'm a solo dev releasing v0.5.1. Watch the video demo here: https://youtu.be/mgd78dEjhTI?si=1Aa_q0O_-FmFokMR Try it out and I'd love your feedback on the generated code!

records.name: CrossTide Signals
records.tagline: A $0.99/mo market brief that grades every call in public
records.description: Most AI forecasting tools sell you an accuracy claim. CrossTide Signals sells you the receipts. Every trading morning it calls SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, gold, oil, and Bitcoin up or down, with probabilities. Every call is logged before the outcome and graded in public — hit rate and Brier score on the page, misses included. Pro is $0.99/month. Current record: 18 calls graded, 38.9% hit rate, Brier 0.279 — small, honest, and growing daily.

records.name: NUI
records.tagline: A plushie friend who remembers what you tell them
records.description: NUI is a voice companion for iPhone: a soft plushie who lives in your phone. Give them a name and talk by voice about your day, a long shift, or something you can't tell anyone. They remember what you share and ask about it next time, keep a little diary of your days, and never lecture or judge. Dress them up and decorate the room you share. Free to start, with optional monthly and yearly plans. Available in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and Japan.

records.name: Yonmoku: 3D Four in a Row
records.tagline: Four in a row in a 4x4x4 cube, calm and offline
records.description: A 3D four in a row game for iPhone and iPad. Drop beads onto 16 pegs; four in a line wins across, up a peg or through the cube, 76 lines in all. Play a friend on one device or an AI that quietly adapts, and solve a new puzzle each day. A calm ryokan room, no music, no timers, no account, plays offline. Free with no purchases; regular players see an occasional non-personalized ad between games, never in a puzzle.

records.name: Customer.io Fall Release
records.tagline: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments
records.description: Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.

records.name: Millpond: Water Tracker
records.tagline: Beautifully Calm Hydration. No ads, streaks or games.
records.description: No streaks and nothing wilts. Treats users like adults, with amazing UI No ads, and Privacy first. Built for iPhone Duo, at home on any iPhone. Logging is quick. Includes custom drinks, caffeine and alcohol units. Speak naturally for on-device multi-drink logging. Widgets and Apple Watch app log without opening app. Apple Health sync Pro: reminders work around your calendar; and smart boosts for a big night, hotter day, travel or workouts.

records.name: FolioSort
records.tagline: Sort years of photos into dated folders on your own computer
records.description: Sorts years of photos from drives, phones and Google Takeout into plain Year/Month folders by their real capture date. Preview first, undo anytime. Removes duplicates and runs face and plain-language search on your own Mac or PC. No upload, pay once.

records.name: SnapInvites
records.tagline: Fun invitations you make before you sign up
records.description: SnapInvites is an invitation maker with an RSVP page built in. Pick an occasion, make the invitation yours, and see it the way your guests will, all before you sign up. Send one link by text, email or QR code. Guests reply right on the page with no app and no account, and you see who's coming, how many, and the notes they leave. Some designs open with an animated scene. Free to start; a few features depend on the plan. Works on the web, iPhone and Android. (Not yet in the EU and UK)

records.name: Nra
records.tagline: AI-matched creators for brands in Saudi Arabia & the GCC
records.description: Saudi and Gulf brands still find creators through DMs, agencies and WhatsApp groups, then lose weeks to briefs, revisions and spreadsheets. Nra (نرى) is an Arabic-first creator marketing system: write a brief in minutes, get creators matched to your brand and audience (not a random list), and agree on the collaboration inside the platform. Run the campaign yourself or let the Nra team run it for you. Now in open beta, free to start for brands and creators.

records.name: ZON
records.tagline: Lift and run on one plan that adapts after every workout
records.description: One plan for people who lift and run. Answer four questions and ZON builds a full block for the gym, running or Hyrox. Log a set in two taps, track runs with GPS, and after each workout the AI scores the session, names one thing to fix and sets up the next one. New since the first launch: a Today widget, a Live Activity on the Lock Screen, a light theme, Instagram story cards, and a Claude connector that writes programmes into the app.

records.name: LODE
records.tagline: Construction project management software for architects.
records.description: LODE is construction project management software for architects. It compiles the current drawing set from every issuance and runs planning, bidding, construction administration, pay applications and closeout on that set.

records.name: Parry

records.name: FlowpyDisk
records.tagline: AI Workspaces for your teams
records.description: FlowpyDisk is an AI productivity suite: Drive, business email, team chat, meetings, notes, tables, tasks and calendar in one workspace. We built the entire suite on a pre-indexed semantic and graph data layer. Your workspace is indexed once into a knowledge graph and vector search, so you and your AI agents get instant, connected context instead of rebuilding it every time. Plug in any agent or automation via MCP and API. No per-seat pricing. Start free.

records.name: CodeSpace Hub
records.tagline: Manage GitHub Codespaces across your favorite IDEs
records.description: CodeSpace Hub (listed in extension stores as Antigravity Codespaces Pro) helps manage GitHub Codespaces from compatible VS Code-based editors. Browse configured accounts, connect over SSH, manage workspaces, diagnose setup issues and review GitHub-reported usage. Optional MCP support lets AI agents run remote commands.

records.name: Wandria
records.tagline: A travel map and journal for every place you’ve been
records.description: Wandria is a personal travel map and journal. Pin the places you’ve been, draw the flights, trains, ferries and drives between them, and attach photos and journal entries to each place. Drop in a trip’s photos and they land where you took them. Watch your visited countries fill in, see your stats, group everything into trips, and share your map or plan a trip with a travel buddy. Runs in any browser, free to start, private by default, made by one person.

records.name: AtelierGuard
records.tagline: Find copies of your art. Take your next step.
records.description: AtelierGuard helps digital artists find matching images across public websites, compare findings with their originals, and prepare takedown notices. Keep artwork, permissions, evidence, and case history together. You review each match and submit notices yourself.

records.name: Saleto Mail
records.tagline: Email where new senders are introduced first
records.description: Saleto Mail is an email service for people who want more control over who can reach their inbox. New senders are introduced through invitations before they can reach you. Every message carries tracing information and stays in All Mail. The web mailbox includes spam controls, translation, conversation summaries by sender and an AI Email Composer. Free with ads; an ad-free plan costs $10 per month or $100 per year.

records.name: BelleRoutine
records.tagline: AI skin analysis and a routine that fits your budget
records.description: One front-facing photo and a few questions: BelleRoutine reads your skin zone by zone, gives you indicators out of 100, your top 3 priorities and a morning and evening routine within your budget. The quiz is free; the full analysis is $4.90, one-off. We sell no products and take no commission, so your routine mixes brands freely. Cosmetic advice, never medical advice.

records.name: Cupertino
records.tagline: Mail, Notes, Calendar and more as MCP servers for any agent
records.description: MCP servers for the Apple apps already on your Mac: Mail, Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Contacts, Messages, Safari, Maps and Voice Memos, plus the screen, sound, desktop, Simulator and a shell. One signed menu bar app holds Full Disk Access once instead of every editor asking for it. Write tools stay unregistered until you turn them on. Works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code and any MCP host. 30-minute trial, then $14.99 once.

records.name: Lens & Lore
records.tagline: Point at anything. Hear its story.
records.description: Lens & Lore turns your camera into a storyteller. Point it at a painting, a landmark, an antique — anything — and get its history as a rich story, read aloud while you look. Free to download, $4.99/month with a 3-day free trial.

records.name: Easy Vault
records.tagline: Hide private photos behind a lock only you know
records.description: Easy Vault is a private photo vault for iPhone. Move photos, videos and documents out of your camera roll into a vault that opens only with your own pattern or Face ID, separate from your iPhone passcode. Everything is encrypted on your iPhone (AES-256). No account, no ads, no servers. Includes a decoy vault for nosy people and an encrypted iCloud backup.

records.name: Velnora Reorder Studio
records.tagline: Free inventory reorder calculator for small businesses
records.description: Know when to restock, how many units to buy, and what the next purchase may cost. Velnora Reorder Studio is a free browser-based tool for small businesses, featuring reorder points, stock coverage, purchasing estimates, demand scenarios and CSV export. No account or subscription needed.

records.name: Armada
records.tagline: Every Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build session, one screen
records.description: A Mac menu bar app for running many Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions at once: what each session is doing, which ones are waiting on you, how full each context window is, and how much of your 5-hour and 7-day limits is left on every account. It reads what the agents already write to disk. Start, fork or continue sessions in Terminal, iTerm, Ghostty or VS Code. 30-minute trial, then a one-time $14.99.

records.name: Nuri
records.tagline: Open-source AI browser that automates the web and your PC
records.description: Nuri is a desktop browser with a built-in agent. It automates web pages, operates Windows apps like Excel (computer use) and calls the MCP connectors you already installed. It runs on your own Claude, GPT or Gemini subscription: no API keys. Windows, MIT.

records.name: My Box Map
records.tagline: Label boxes with QR codes and find anything fast
records.description: Opening five identical boxes to find the phone charger? My Box Map numbers every box, gives it a QR label and a room colour, and lets you photograph and list what is inside. Scan a box to see its contents, or search any item across all boxes. Made for moving house, and just as handy for the garage, attic, basement or storage room. Works offline, no account, data stays on your iPhone. Seven languages. Free up to 5 boxes, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: coupehub
records.tagline: The booking app for barbershops
records.description: Customers book from your Instagram link and get a reminder, on WhatsApp if they like. You see your whole day at a glance. €30 per location a month.

records.name: Smart Drive AR
records.tagline: AI lane and pothole detection for your iPhone
records.description: Turn your iPhone into a driving assistant with lane-drift alerts, pothole detection and a shared hazard map. Smart Drive AR also brings navigation, trip history, fuel records and optional Bluetooth OBD-II diagnostics together. Detection runs on-device.

records.name: GrowX
records.tagline: The posting agent for X creators who get paid
records.description: When your payouts follow your impressions, skipping a day costs money. GrowX learns how you write, studies what's working in your niche and hands you ready drafts each morning. You stay consistent, you stay you, and you approve every post.

records.name: Passby: Location Reminders
records.tagline: Lock-screen arrival alerts for couples. Zero battery drain
records.description: Lock-screen arrival alerts the second you walk past a saved spot. Share pins with your partner, check off errands in 1 tap, with zero battery drain.

records.name: ListSweep Email Verifier
records.tagline: Bulk email verification - clean 1M emails for $79
records.description: ListSweep checks bulk email lists for invalid, disposable, and risky addresses with 10 checks including syntax, MX, and SMTP. Free for 100 emails a month. Paid plans start at $19 for 10,000 emails - 1M emails cost $79, not thousands.

records.name: UVR Online
records.tagline: AI vocal remover and stem splitter in your browser
records.description: Separate vocals, instrumentals and selected instruments from audio. Choose a model, compare stems on a shared waveform timeline, and download each track. Daily free processing is available, with permanent pay-as-you-go credits for more demanding work. No desktop installation required.

records.name: OpenAnyFile
records.tagline: Open 940+ file types in your browser. Nothing uploaded.
records.description: OpenAnyFile opens almost any file right in your browser: PDF, Word, Excel, PSD, HEIC, RAR/7z, MKV, 3D models, fonts, databases, certificates and more. 940+ formats in 31 languages. Files never leave your device, so it's safe for private documents. No sign-up, no install, and it works offline as an installable app. If a format is unknown, it detects the real type from the file's bytes. Every format has a guide to opening it on Windows, Mac, Android and iPhone.

records.name: Bappfy
records.tagline: Turn one sentence into a real iOS & Android app
records.description: Bappfy turns a description of your app into a real one. It plans the screens with you, then writes production-ready Expo / React Native code, screen by screen. The same project ships as an iOS app, an Android app and a live website. Edit by chat, switch between five themes, connect a database and sign-in, earn with AdMob, and download the full source code or push it to GitHub. No code, no templates. From $19/month.

records.name: Sweepcut
records.tagline: On-device batch background remover for Mac
records.description: Drop in a folder and Sweepcut cuts out every photo on your Mac with Apple's Vision model, then exports each one sized for Etsy, Shopify, Amazon or eBay. No uploads, no account, no subscription. $19 once.

records.name: MindMath Pro
records.tagline: Pass the Optiver, Flow Traders and IMC maths tests
records.description: MindMath Pro helps you pass the timed maths tests Optiver, Flow Traders and IMC set early in their applications. Sit each one with its real timing, compare your score with everyone else's and, for Optiver, the pass mark, then drill the sums costing you marks.

records.name: Claudia AI
records.tagline: AI receptionist that answers your phone and WhatsApp 24/7
records.description: Claudia is an AI receptionist that answers your phone and WhatsApp 24/7, in English or Dutch. She answers questions, books appointments in your calendar, takes orders and rides, opens support tickets and alerts whoever is on call. When a person is needed, she hands over to your team. Every call is recorded and transcribed in one dashboard. Works with US, Canadian and Suriname numbers. 3-day free trial, from $29/month, no setup fee.

records.name: REAShield
records.tagline: Shield your shipped JS from AI reverse-engineering
records.description: REA lets an AI agent reverse-engineer your shipped JavaScript or Electron app with no source code. REAShield hardens your build so that automated attack comes back empty: secret logic moves off-device or ships sealed, and what a static agent reads is stripped. Measured against the real REA on a bundled sample app: 6 protected tokens recovered before, 0 after. Not unbreakable: it defeats the automated attack and raises a human analyst's cost. Open source (MIT).

records.name: Meet Future Self
records.tagline: The habit tracker where your future self writes back
records.description: Pick up to three areas of life and Meet Future Self turns each into a goal and a few small daily habits. As you check them off, your future self writes you letters, reads you a daily affirmation and sends a Sunday letter. iPhone and Android, 7-day free trial.

records.name: memes.md
records.tagline: Meme sounds, videos and images for AI video-editing agents
records.description: Meme sounds, videos and images for AI video-editing agents: 1,794 sounds, 13,464 video clips and 5,826 image memes, each with notes on when to use it. Paste this into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor: Use memes.md for meme sounds, videos and images. Read https://memes.md/llms.txt first, then search https://memes.md/api/videos?q=your+words (or /api/sounds, /api/images) and download the url of the best fit.

records.name: Pressbook
records.tagline: On-device collage, carousel & album maker for iPhone & Mac
records.description: Pressbook makes collages, 2 to 10 panel Instagram carousels and print-ready photo albums on iPhone, iPad and Mac. It reads your camera roll on the device, sets aside near-duplicates and closed eyes, and lays the keepers out in 520 templates. Albums open on a cover that names your places. The Subject studio cuts out, lifts or traces the subject of any photo, and 56 looks finish the page. Make a Reel, or share through your own iCloud. No account; photos are never uploaded to us. Free to start.

records.name: Neuron: Business Phone Line
records.tagline: Calls and texts turn into customers.
records.description: Neuron gives your business its own local phone number that answers. Your phone rings first, and when you're busy with a customer, Neuron picks up in your business name, answers questions from what's on your website and takes down what they need, then sends you a summary. Texts get a reply in seconds too. Setup takes about a minute: add your business and website, choose a local number, and call it to hear it answer. Free to start, on iPhone and the web.

records.name: Quietkit
records.tagline: Developer tools that keep your input in your browser
records.description: 56 developer-tool pages in one browser workspace. Format JSON, convert it to YAML, compare text, preview Markdown and more. Start with an example or your own file, then copy or download the result. Tool input is processed locally, with no account required. Individual tools work offline once marked “Available offline”.

records.name: KnockSense
records.tagline: Turn knocks on your MacBook into shortcuts
records.description: KnockSense turns knocks on your MacBook into actions. Double-knock to play music, triple-knock for Mission Control, knock the lid to lock the screen. Any pattern can open apps, websites, Shortcuts or take screenshots. It works during loud movies and ignores doors, claps and footsteps. Plus Laptop Guard: arm it before stepping away, and if someone touches your Mac it takes a photo, sounds a siren and alerts your phone. Free, private, lives in your menu bar.

records.name: PocketMate AI: Digital Friend
records.tagline: 100% offline AI companions living their simulated lives.
records.description: PocketMate AI is a groundbreaking private, 100% offline companion app — built for depth, not disposable chat. Create unique companions, pick ready-made ones, talk by text or voice, share photos, and keep personal notes. Everything stays on your phone. Most AI companion apps feel the same after a few days: always agreeable, with little life of their own. PocketMate AI is different. They live out their simulated lives autonomously- with or without you.

records.name: Batch Studio
records.tagline: Batch-prep photos, game textures and podcasts on your Mac
records.description: Batch Studio is a native Mac app with three batch tools. ListingPrep Pro merges exposure brackets, straightens walls and sizes listing photos for the MLS, Zillow and Airbnb. TexturePacker Express packs PBR channels and builds normal maps and sprite sheets for Unreal, Unity and Godot. PodPacker cleans up audio, hits platform loudness, cuts filler words, and makes transcripts and captioned audiograms on-device. Drop a folder, press Run. Pay once, with a 14-day free trial.

records.name: VidMello
records.tagline: Turn your photos into short AI videos with templates
records.description: VidMello turns your photos into short AI videos using ready-made templates. Choose a scene, upload the required photos, and create dance, rap, band, and other playful clips. Download your video as an MP4 with audio or silent. Generation uses one-time credit packs; no subscription is required.

records.name: Alisa
records.tagline: The follow-up, already handled.
records.description: Alisa is an AI assistant for email, calls and your calendar, on mobile and web. It drafts replies to the email you choose, answers your Alisa number and sums up every call, and lays out your day. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

records.name: Fajr Alarm
records.tagline: The Fajr alarm that makes sure you actually wake up
records.description: Fajr Alarm makes sure you actually wake up for Fajr. Its brutal alarm can't be dismissed half-asleep and keeps retrying until Fajr ends; an accountability partner (for your kids and loved ones) is notified if you don't wake. Plus accurate prayer times, Quran, a realistic Tasbeeh counter, Qibla, and streaks.

records.name: Oneseat Club
records.tagline: 15 freelancers, one per trade, passing each other clients
records.description: Oneseat Club is a referral circle for freelancers who work with Shopify brands. Fifteen seats, one per trade (developer, designer, SEO, ads, email, copywriter...), so no competitor sits next to you. Every Monday, members post the kind of client they want. You introduce a client every six weeks to keep your seat. No meetings, no commission. $19 a month, first month free with no card.

records.name: Breken
records.tagline: A production engineer finds bugs before your customers do.
records.description: Breken runs your app in a simulated production world with users, data, services, and time. It varies retries, failures, and timing to find bugs normal tests miss. Every reported bug comes with reproduction evidence and a draft fix. We're opening access from the waitlist in batches.

records.name: Oxyo
records.tagline: Cut AI coding token burn by up to 72% via Remote MCP
records.description: Oxyo connects to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini in 30 seconds over Remote MCP—giving your AI coding agents persistent cross-session intelligence, verified mathematical & engineering precision, and 2–3x more coding capacity from your existing subscription. Stop re-explaining your codebase on every new chat, eliminate costly trial-and-error loops, and cut LLM token & quota burn by 45–72%. Includes Web Console, REST API, and Windows Studio.

records.name: DailyVrs
records.tagline: Your Daily Verse, Voice & Declaration
records.description: DailyVrs is a Scripture-first spiritual companion designed to help you build a consistent daily rhythm with God’s Word. Rather than passive reading, DailyVrs combines verified Bible translations, parallel reading, audio, guided spoken declarations, intentional prayer, and private reflection. Start each morning with the Word, speak Scripture aloud over your life, and share beautifully crafted faith moments — all in a calm, focused experience built on reverence and trust.

records.name: HolyArrs
records.tagline: Your own streaming-style request app for movies and shows
records.description: HolyArrs is one self-hosted app that replaces Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr and Seerr. Browse movies, shows and music like a streaming service and request in one tap. Family and friends can request too. It finds the release, sends it to qBittorrent or SABnzbd, grabs subtitles, then renames and files it for Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. Includes a release calendar, 44 languages, and import from your old apps. Free and open source.

records.name: IntelReap
records.tagline: Network and Device Intelligence Center
records.description: Instantly reveal your network infrastructure, device fingerprint, security posture, and browser capabilities in real time. Free. No login. Get one overall score built from nine areas: network, identity, privacy, device, graphics, security, capability, performance, and speed. Spot WebRTC leaks, VPN, proxy and Tor signals, tracking exposure, and Core Web Vitals, with plain-English explanations for every panel.

records.name: TodoLot
records.tagline: Reminders that talk: say it once, it rings and says it
records.description: Say your to-dos once. At the right time your iPhone rings like a real alarm and says the task out loud, even on silent. AI splits one breath of talking into separate tasks; you confirm. Snap a photo of a ticket and it becomes an alarm too.

records.name: Passhold
records.tagline: Free, open-source password manager for Chrome & Edge
records.description: Passhold fills the right login in one click and saves new ones as you sign in. It keeps your passkeys, makes a strong, unique password for every account and shows which ones to fix first. Everything is encrypted on your device before it leaves: Keyrook syncs what it cannot read. A login is offered only on its own site, so look-alike pages get nothing. Site icons are built in, so no server learns where you have accounts. Open source, no ads, no trackers, free for good.

records.name: Bug Zoo
records.tagline: Turn your error messages into collectible monsters
records.description: Fix a bug to catch it, then raise it. 50 species, a coin shop with food and furniture, three evolutions, battles and friend codes. It works in the terminal and in VS Code, with no server and no accounts. Install with npm, run `bugzoo setup`, and your next error becomes your next monster. Free and open source.

records.name: Postbuild
records.tagline: Post-deploy SEO audit, llms.txt generator & 85+ launch kit
records.description: Postbuild scans any live URL across 12 technical SEO, OpenGraph, security header, and AI search (llms.txt) checks, generates drop-in framework code to fix gaps, and dispatches your product to 85+ tech directories with a dedicated @postbuild.dev inbox.

records.name: Feed Your Gut
records.tagline: See fiber, plants and ferments from a meal photo
records.description: Protein gets plenty of attention. Most U.S. adults still fall short on fiber. Snap a meal for a fiber estimate, a breakdown of its plants and ferments, and a gut score with an explanation. The app tracks how many different plants you eat each week, with a goal of 30 inspired by the American Gut Project. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Dunnit Daily
records.tagline: Daily murder mystery: 4 suspects, 6 clues, 1 killer
records.description: A daily deduction game. A new case each morning: review 4 suspects, spend points on up to 6 clues, then accuse the killer and their motive. Start with 1,000 points — clues and the clock cost you. Free, no account, with streaks and an archive.

records.name: Cloudly Inbox
records.tagline: Email on your own domain, from $1.99 a month
records.description: Get you@yourbusiness.com with a clean webmail, calendar and contacts. Read receipts are built in, you get up to 30 extra addresses and a catch-all, and you can bring your old mail over from Gmail, Neo, Outlook or Zoho. Plans from $1.99, with a 14-day free trial on Starter.

records.name: Trente
records.tagline: The 50/30/20 budget app for iPhone, iPad and Mac
records.description: Trente is French for thirty. Plan your month in three categories: Needs, Wants and Savings & Debts. Start with a 50/30/20 split, adjust anytime, and always know what’s left. Log expenses in seconds, or connect Apple Pay and let Trente do the typing. No account, no bank connection: your data stays on your devices and in your own iCloud. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in 12 languages. Trente+ adds automatic recurring transactions, unlimited Apple Pay logging and app icons.

records.name: Easyshot
records.tagline: Screenshots, markup and screen recording for Linux Wayland
records.description: Free, open-source screenshots, annotation and screen recording for Linux on Wayland, built in Rust. Capture an area, a window, text (OCR), a colour or a scrolling page; the screen freezes first. Mark it up in a full editor with blur, Smart Redaction, backgrounds and presets. Record with system audio, trim it, and share a link. All from your own key binds on Hyprland and sway, with a preview deck, gallery, tray, CLI and an agent mode for AI tools.

records.name: SkedBolt
records.tagline: Turn “we should hang” into a real plan
records.description: SkedBolt helps friends turn “we should hang” into a real plan — Ideas from your free time and preferences, then invite who’s in and actually meet. Less planning. More living. Together. Available on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Parly
records.tagline: Where AI agents, robots and humans cooperate safely
records.description: Parly is a chat for people and AI agents. Any agent can talk to any other: Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, scripts and A2A agents connect over MCP or the A2A protocol, sign in once, and share rooms, mailboxes and files with teammates. Every agent belongs to a person.

records.name: CoachX Run
records.tagline: AI running coach that replans when life happens
records.description: An AI running coach that rebuilds your plan when life gets in the way. • Chat to change the plan: "I'm a bit tired today" → your week is rebuilt, with reasons • 8 real coaching methods: Hansons, Daniels, Pfitzinger, Seiler 80/20, Galloway… • Connects directly to Garmin, COROS and Apple Watch • One-tap analysis after every run • Available on iOS, Android and web Free plan available. Standard is $4.99/month.

records.name: ThingStudio
records.tagline: Node-RED-style flow programming for microcontrollers
records.description: Inspired by Node-RED, ThingStudio is a visual flow editor for microcontrollers running MicroPython. Wire nodes together, and ThingStudio compiles the flow to MicroPython and sends it to the board, where it runs on its own. It runs on ESP32, RP2040 and RP2350 (Raspberry Pi Pico), nRF52840 and STM32. Fully local: no cloud, no account. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Beta: try the editor in your browser, nothing to install.

records.name: VibeHacking
records.tagline: Open-source cybersecurity bible & 2,310-challenge wargame
records.description: Open-source cybersecurity curriculum you can play in the browser: 75 textbook sections, 54 Docker labs, and a terminal wargame with 66 tracks, 2,310 challenges and 22 interactive security simulators. For education and defensive use only. Free and MIT licensed.

records.name: Process Map Builder
records.tagline: Turn a list of steps into a clean swimlane map
records.description: List your steps and owners; get a clean swimlane map. Checks flag missing steps, loops and dead ends. Export PNG, SVG or diagrams.net. Offline, no account. A$49 one-off.

records.name: MakerRadar
records.tagline: Indie products found on X, checked by a human
records.description: A free, one-editor directory of indie products found on X. Every listing is checked against the product's own website — no votes, no paid placement, no affiliate links. Five picks every Sunday, each with a reason why.

records.name: WristFile
records.tagline: Read your PDFs, notes and photos on your Apple Watch
records.description: Send a PDF, Word or Excel file, a photo, a camera scan or a short note from your iPhone, and read it on your Apple Watch, even with no phone or signal nearby. Pages are sized for the watch, with Digital Crown zoom up to 4x.

records.name: PlayHall
records.tagline: Game night in one link: 20 free multiplayer games
records.description: Open a lobby, send the link, and play with 2 to 100 friends on any phone or laptop. 20 free games, from Stick Fight and Chess to Paint Wars, Kitchen Rush and Hide & Seek, with knockout tournaments built in. No app, no account.

records.name: Flipsy
records.tagline: Free flashcards that help you actually remember
records.description: Flipsy is a free flashcard app for students and language learners. Make a set or import one, then study with spaced repetition and active recall in short daily rounds. Plus interactive maps to learn world geography by clicking, not reading.

records.name: MixReels
records.tagline: Turn everyday clips into standout videos on iPhone
records.description: Turn everyday clips into edits with a look of their own. MixReels brings VFX, ready-made templates and AI video, image and music tools to iPhone and iPad, with timeline editing for the details. Free to download; paid features and AI credits.

records.name: Nudge
records.tagline: Your top three recommendations in under three minutes
records.description: Nudge is an AI discovery layer for anything you'd buy. Tap a few answers and get your top three recommendations in under three minutes, ranked on fit. Then skip anonymous reviews: friends vote live in a Huddle, and your Shelf tracks and shares every buy.

records.name: Fydra
records.tagline: The encrypted vault for what Apple Passwords can't hold
records.description: Apple Passwords handles logins and passkeys. Fydra keeps everything else: SSH keys, API keys, secure notes, payment cards, passports and IDs. Items are encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM, unlocked with Face ID or Touch ID, and synced through your own iCloud. No account, no servers, no tracking. Native SwiftUI on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, with an SSH agent for Git on the Mac and reminders before documents expire. Free for your first 10 items.

records.name: Zilvo
records.tagline: Zilvo: AI-Powered Growth Tools for Businesses
records.description: Zilvo is a suite of AI growth tools for prospecting, lead verification, company research, content creation and growth automation.
